t: Greetings! It's interesting to see living things in this swamp... I'm studying the local ghostly creatures here.
You know, this doesn't make me want to go anywhere. I can look at all sorts of things here... There are Junes, gnats... What else do I need?
h: If you come with me, I'll show you something...

t: I have everything I need! Look: a microscope, a net, storage containers...
h: If you come with me, I'll give you something...

t: Oh Tensess protect me, why are you pestering me?!
h: I really need you to come with me!

t: Hey, newbie! You say we need to go back... But I'm hurt. I need {price} measures of Spark energy... to move faster.
No, I can't do that yet...
Many things. Right now, I'm helping a troop leader. This place is packed, isn't it? That's why the leaders need help. They didn't expect the season to last for so long.

Slavyana Yaseneva! I'm a pioneer now, but I used to live in a small village on Malar. Our allod is very peaceful. It's been inhabited since ancient times, when Kania was one, not broken into tiny islands. Nothing ever happens, not even demonic attacks. We don't have major cities, but there are many towns and villages. And we have huge forests, so easy for an outsider to get lost in.

You! Haha... I remember. Wings cut through the night, the fire burns... Those were the days!

But we are done! Can you hear me?! The fortress, once white as the snow, now as dark as the night!

Four hours! Four hours!

Haha...
The stone... The stone floats... Thunder! The thunderstorm is coming! To arms!

Who awakened me?

Who was it? I slept and dreamed... What kind of dreams did I have...? I remember the tree that lost its leaves, as though fall had come. I remember the rains in the city of the dead on dark rivers, I remember the majestic pyramids that stand in the middle of the desert valleys...
The shadows have awakened, and they are calling to us.
Oh, my head is killing me...
I don’t know... When I woke up, I was alone here. The last thing I remember was falling into a trance... And then... no, I don’t remember anything. Maybe others have recovered and left?
Oh, my dear friendlady, enough empty talk. Let's talk business first...
Oh, if you help me, I'll tell you what I know... And not just that: once you've talked to everyone, come back me - I'll give you good advice.
h: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

t: You smell with blood! What do you want?

Here, take it.

It is a part of the other stone alien. Looks like a face. The other alien had a face. He fought the first stone aliens. They broke his face in battle. Take it.
Do you want to increase the level of proficiency in professions? This is easy.
Enough with this nonsense! There is no way a distinguished scientist and theorist like me can vegetate in this hole!

Yes, you have understood correctly. All that "devilry" you may have heard of in the village is nothing but field test operations of our latest intelligence equipment. By the way, those tests failed. You know what it means? It means that we are staying here until we succeed!

I'm so sick and tired of those bureaucrats shoving me around. Imagine the stink they will raise when they find out that someone has broken that hugely expensive third version of the walking hut, stuffed with intelligence devices, and stolen the only prototype of Variator! The thieves will probably think that it is just a regular wand at the best-case scenario. Or a digging stick at the worst. And it's a real wonder of magic technology!

Well, you know the truth now. You will have to decide for yourself what to do about it. I don't really care. Don't forget that, If you jeopardize our mission, my colleagues will try to eliminate you. Where they are? Haha, they are right in front of you. How many real animals you think are left in this forest?

Happy blissful New Year!
If you like the New Year's celebration, I'll gladly help you decorate the town with fir trees and garlands, make a snowman or play snowballs! And if you have holiday postcards, I'll exchange them for presents and souvenirs.

h: Exchange your souvenirs for New Year cards

t: The Snow Owl has adapted to extreme conditions. It flies higher than others.
You haven't tamed a Snow Owl yet! It will not serve you.
The Snowbug is slow but stubborn. His wings protect the rider from cold and snowballs. It can fly, too.

quests: Pledge of Punishment: Werebears of the Darkwater

t: Behold the miracles the Lord has granted you - a breakthrough in revival technology. There is no need for useless Servants and Purgatory, everything happens here thanks to this machine. Over time, it will revive all the dead in Sarnaut.

This is a great machine - a converter of energy into matter. Do you know the great wisdom that all matter is energy, and energy is matter, and it is equal to mass multiplied by speed of light squared? However, it doesn't matter, in your world no one will understand this anyway. Another thing is important - with the help of the power received from the Great Mages, the machine transforms it into invisible particles, and it also collects new objects from them - the earth of allods, the bodies of the revived... It doesn't matter what - the machine can do everything.
h: What kind of machine is this?

t: I was and remain a Servant of the Lord, but now the Lord has gone on a long journey to another world, the world of Light where he wants to find answers to his questions. Now we, the Servants of the Lord, serve his faithful daughter and her followers.

What are you doing? Hanging around? Doing nothing? Pestering people?

Alright, no offence. I have a business offer. Do you like me?

Oh, that sounded wrong. That's not the type of fairy I am. I have someone who owes me. How about I sell her to you? She can be your servant. All I need is the shiny things elves use for payment and some fairy dust, tee hee hee.

Bring me enough, and you can have this Spark-Shark all you want.
It's everywhere on Irene. You just need to look. Some guests find it, but since they don't really need it, they might share it with you, tee hee hee.
Hello, hello! Have you got shiny baubles?
Blood and sand, just blood and sand. Only the one who is strong can win in the arena! And the fate of the weak is to fall!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: The Spirits of the Ancestors are silent...
What a surprise! I knew I'd see you again... Fish bones told me something about you... Hmm, I forgot what exactly... But I remember that you need to be wary of scissors...

Yes, I wouldn’t mind taking revenge, or else we’ll die and be ashamed to look our brother in the eye when we meet... Jon won't forgive me if we don't deal with this fish...

Well, if a capable warrior like you says we can win, then we can do it! And if we fail, then we’ll die a glorious death - let people sing sagas about us! I swear by the stellate sturgeon!
h: I'll help. We have dealt with worse. Let's avenge Jon!

t:
Well, are you dry now? Warmed up?

And why in the world would you jump into the sea? Lyngbakr would have devoured you on the spot if my guys hadn't been around.

Your mug is suspicious, it looks like an Orc's...Some have mentioned the Urun, but I see that you don't much look like one.We're wondering what kind of beast you are...We're wondering what kind of beast you are...We're wondering what kind of beast you are...We're wondering what kind of beast you are...We're wondering what kind of beast you are...We see that you are Gibberlings, but clearly not from around here, because I know everyone in this place.

That's how the story goes!

Of course, that Lyngbakr died a long time ago, and ours is a small herring compared to its great-grandfather.

Only this herring is the size of my boat!

Once my brother and sister and I dreamed of great spoils and fame. For three days and three nights we chased Lyngbakr across the sea, until this creature took a bite out of the boat along with our brother Jon.

Since then...

Eh, my friend...

No, I won't go after Lyngbakr.
We're coming after you, Lyngbakr! Yo-ho-ho!
Salmon swallow me if you don't enter the songs of our clan after this!

It's… brother Jon's helmet! Oh, our poor, poor brother…

Jon was… the bravest in our family. He dreamed of travelling the world, even though we are trapped on Isa now. I wanted to help my brother, but I didn't know how... the only thing I could do was join the hunt for dangerous fish...

And that's how it ended!

Yes, many of us want to leave Isa, and Jon was one of them...

Thank you for helping us recover at least that. Our brother's boat in Misty Harbor will be a good place for the helmet.
h: Show the helmet found in the belly of the fish

t:
I send everyone there twice a day. You can see the time in your own calendar. I can send you there from anywhere in Sarnaut, you don't have to come here, hehe. Just sign up for the Skirmish the way you usually do when you want to beat someone up at the Witch's Hollow or anywhere else.

You will need keys to open the chests. I'll give you ten per week, but you can save up a two-week supply of them if you want.

The rest is simple: go to the island alone, search for chests, fight other treasure hunters, take their loot, don't let others take it from you.

To open a chest, you need to wait until it "thaws". When you take a new treasure, your chests "freeze" again. When you run out of keys, I will bring you back. But when time runs out, all the participants will also be back, and their chests will immediately open.
h: Tell me about the Melting Isle and whatever is happening there!

t:
He he...

So, if you remember, this island was full of treasures buried somewhere in the ice. Over time, the island began to thaw, and treasures began to appear here and there, to the delight of greedy heroes. But all good things come to an end eventually. Over time, the Melting Isle was exhausted.

Forgotten and abandoned, it peacefully drifted through the astral plane. Until the "boom" on Suslanger. This Ambrosia of yours was thrown into space and, carried by the astral currents, began to spread... This stream affected the Melting Isle as well.

Divine energies caused temporal anomalies which revived the treasures you had plundered - June artifacts got filled with this power, turning into something else. And now, the island is again full of treasures.

Of course we will change the rules. Guild Wars? Pfft, boring. It's every man for himself! Of course, I know you, and you will definitely try to cheat... But it won't be easy!
h: Tell me about the return of the Melting Isle

t:
It's all very simple. I send players there twice a day. I can send you there from anywhere in Sarnaut, you don't have to come here. Just sign up for a Skirmish. You can see the time in your own calendar.

You will need keys to open the chests. I'll give you ten per week, but you can save up a two-week supply of them if you want.

The rest is simple: go to the island alone, search for chests, fight other treasure hunters, take their loot, don't let others take it from you.

To open a chest, you need to wait until it "thaws". When you pick up a new treasure, your chests "freeze" again. When you run out of keys, I will bring you back, sorry. But when time runs out, all the participants will also be back, and their chests will immediately open.

In addition, some surprises await you. The Ambrosia energy affecting the Melting Isle has created interesting orbs that boost you... or your enemies if they find them first. But there's a stipulation - if you have collected too many treasures, the orbs will no longer work for you.

And don't even try to go there with a group - it won't work!
h: How is the treasure hunt going?
I want to get my reward for Glacier Ice Shards

t: Here is what I can give you. Take your pick. Use that while we're testing it. For now it's free.
There's nothing like stabbing someone in the back for a treasure.

quests: Threads of Fate: Oblivion by Fire

t:
Not great... I was looking for a steel workpiece in the shape of a zigzag... I found it, but I can't reach it! It's over there, on the roof of this thing in front of me...

I tried to get there, but no luck - either I'd slip and hurt my leg, or the ladder would fall apart.

Maybe you'll have better luck? I'm going to take a break, it's your turn now...
h: Greetings. How is the search for the piece going?

t: Hello, hello! Wanna eat? You'll have to work for it!
Yes, you've become favored among women! That means I have something for you... I hope you enjoy it!

What disposition you are talking about?! They are just beating us into the ground! They're absolutely insane. I can't begin to count how many of us were killed.

Do you want to help? Beat the enemy! Or pick up the batteries from the bodies - we need them here more!

Another Crystal? Thanks goodness! I thought the last one burned five minutes ago.

See that huge cannon? Without this crystal it's just a pile of metal scrap. It's too bad crystals burn too quickly!

What are you waiting for? Install the crystal and start the fire!
As you touch the crystal, the black stones of the Tensess Temple on Asee-Teph appear before your eyes.
As you touch the crystal, Ferris, covered in ice, and all the horrors that live in its laboratories, emerge in front of your eyes.
As you touch the crystal, the memory of Gorislav and Gipatian Ghosts comes to you.
As you touch the crystal, the scorching sun of Suslanger burns your skin, and Alice's last moments in this world spring to mind.
As you touch the crystal, you remember the gloomy and sick Umoir and corrupted Catherina's explosive temper.

Golly! It's fun here! We had no idea you gathered like this every year, otherwise we would've found our way here ages ago, ha ha! I'm joking!

Yes, we have visited many places - Siveria, the Frozen Frontier, and Lightwood. We didn’t like what we saw: our kin are mistreated. Other nations have more land, and what we have is of poor quality. But we'll talk about this later.

I'll go fight these orcs!

I talked to Khasim yesterday. He needs... samples for his research. Is that what they are called? Apparently people are willing to pay a lot for it... So I'm putting together a caravan. The desert has always been dangerous, but now it's doubly so. I'm trying to find a few brave guys who'll join me. If it sounds like something you're interested in, perhaps we could go together?

Oh, Khasim, my unfortunate friend. Everyone turned their backs on him after what he did...

But I see big... as they say in the capital... potential!

This Ambrosia is... a valuable thing, they say. And Khasim understands how it all works. So I'm wondering how his skills might help me make a profit...
h: What business do you have with Khasim Kehelin?

t: I'm Stanislav Karamzin. A famous merchant! Everyone knows and respects me on this allod. I can get you anything - I have contacts even in the capital!

I have an odd feeling.

I think I can hear animals' thoughts... and plants', too. Are they also intelligent here?

It's very unusual. I'd rather lose marbles myself, hah!

You know, it's been a lot of pressure. You know me, I'm down to earth. All I want is marry Fury, play goblinball, and stay away from dumb fights. I'm sorry. It's just too much...
h: What do you think about the new world?

t: Mirror, mirror, tell me, should I smash the enemy who stands before me?
Faith... On my road I have always kept faith, unlike everyone else. But in what? Who was I?
Thank you! I remember everything! Gods, I am coming!

quests: A Glimpse into Astral Ship Building

t: The twelfth regiment reports that enemy forces have been spotted in the area and they must be eliminated.
I have a good liqueur stashed away, if no one has drank it!
Thank Nezeb! I've been waiting for so long!
Let them attack! We will let them taste our Imperial blades!

What brings you here?

Are you serious?

Look around you! This is Umoir! The heart of the blighted lands. You still don't get it? Ah, I always have to explain everything.

I study the Astral. Or rather, the possibility of creating something from it. Yes, right now we can create allods from the Astral. You probably have one, too... So what? I hired goblins to guard the labyrinth, then forgot about it. It's nothing.

Creation of life! That's all that matters.

By studying the Blight, we can figure out how the Astral influences the living. They have similar effects... I have an idea, and Zayan agreed to help me in exchange for my services. I'll tell you about it later, when I'm done with the calculations.
h: Good day, sculptor! What brings you here?

t: Art is my calling. And you have the incredible opportunity to assist Stephane de Doucer himself!
I am ready to help in any way!

A self-propelled combat device which delivers defensive fire. Only suits for ranged combat.

Falconet is the best option for those who seek great fire power for their group.

Pimen does not attack enemies but devotes himself to healing and supporting his allies. The powers of nature, to which he appeals, help him pull them even from the grip of death.

Pimen will effectively increase the survivability of your group, though don't forget that he needs constant protection.
Soon. Would you stop asking? Damn freeloaders...
h: The boatswain is asking when the food will be ready.

t:
Humm... Do you want to know the words, pronounced so long ago, shortling?

Aye, I do remember them... My grandfather's grandfather wasn't even a seed when the words were said... humm... We remember. We remember many things... humm...

The same year when the Darkness first came, people with the red bark were fighting in the ruined city...

Some of them decided to turn to the Dark. They summoned him at night, begging, reminding him about the given promise... humm... The Dark only laughed. He said, by the break of dawn the people with the red bark will be free from the Curse...

When the sun rose, they cried with horror. Those who rejected the Dark's help looked at their kin and recoiled with disgust... humm...

Their appearance was horrendous. They weren't people anymore. They were beasts with tentacles on their faces. No longer the sun-loving Junes with red bark. They became cold and slimy creatures, fond of dump dungeons.

They had nothing in common. That was the Dark's gift... humm...
h: Oh wise Treant, do you know about the Junes' decision, witnessed by the sky, water, and woods?

t:
Humm... The history says nothing. The sky won't talk about it, the earth won't say it, the wind won't whisper in the leaves...

Unless the filth that's eating the earth talks. Someone once told me that sometimes it sings. Humm... I don't know his name, but this man's fate was bound to astral... Something happened to him out there, in astral... something very important. I'm sorry, that is all I know... humm...

If you find him, give him a piece of my bark. He should remember our talk.
h: What happened to those who rejected the Darks' gift?

t: Which came first, an acorn or an oak? Humm...
How interesting... It's been a while since I've seen anything but the Grove of the First, and the world has changed... Our power is growing...

The prophecies have been fulfilled! If you have had a chance to get acquainted with the Saga of Thorri, Lok and Wald, then you probably know about Seida's prophecy. Just imagine - it is more than three thousand years old, and it spoke about you and your deeds. Of course, much remains unclear, much of what she predicted may not have come true yet.
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t:
It is time:

The maiden Seida's

Words must be remembered.

The moment is near.

Behold the sinister city

Full of shadows and spiders!

You will walk the path

Of visions and dreams.

Be wary of strangers

You may encounter.

Broken threads

Cannot be tied together reliably.

Arson, you say? I heard about it... We have a club here, and everyone is ready to riot, to overthrow the empress... A girl gave a speech recently... What was her name... Anita? Alina? Alice! Yes. So someone decided... to set fire...
Hmm... The right lung is comprised of three lobes... The superior lobe of the lungs has inferior borders extending posteriorly to the fourth rib for right and left lung...
Conspiracy, you say? I heard about it... We have a club here, and everyone is ready to riot, to overthrow the empress... Without Alice this time!

If the Great Void - or the Astral, as you call it - is a large ocean, then it must have its own Lyngbakr... Oh, we've heard all about the Octulhu. You might not believe it, but we've already hunted one with Froddy and the crew of the Sparrow. They were saying something about some Battle Campaign and that they urgently needed to kill ten Octulhus... As I understand it, these campaigns of yours are something like our Winter Watch...

But there must be fish bigger than this Octhulhu!
My brothers allow me to take rule for an hour! And should I say, I do not mind!
Summer always comes after winter and spring. There is no way that I deal with you before my elder brothers, January and March.
This is our world and that's all you need to know.
h: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: Welcome! We spare nothing for our guests! If you serve the city well, we will reward you with valuable prizes!

Who am I, you ask? Hmm, hmm...

For a thousand years after Yok, I've been sustaining life in the fading Muspel volcano... Do you understand that the volcano on an isolated island would die?

If it weren't for me, it would certainly have happened, and this valley would have been covered with snow, and the Gibberlings would no longer have mead to keep them warm in fierce winters!

The vicious Urun endure frosts much better, and without mead, the Gibberlings will no longer be able to withstand their onslaught... Hmm...

Once every few hundred years, the Urun tried to besiege the valley, but the Zvergs that lived in the caves used to stop the Uruns from making their way here. But two hundred years ago, the Zvergs disappeared, and I lost my defenders.

Yes, I loved the Zverg people and helped them forge their beautiful tools and decorations. I even took up the hammer myself at times, hmm.
h: And who are you? And what are you doing?

t:
Yes, that is indeed the work of the Zvergs! But the metal is unfamiliar to me...

You say it's a heavenly metal that once fell on our land? Hmm… I'll have to disappoint you: I know about a place that was said to be spawned by sky stones, but it's far from the Great Ash Tree… There's nothing but the skeletons of the Great Dragons there…

Maybe such a metal did exist, but you won't find it in the depths of the current Isa.

We could learn more from the miners, but alas... the Zverg people have disappeared two hundred years ago.

Hmm. Interesting! People have been eyeing me strangely, especially those two goblins! Let me guess - they aren't fond of trolls here, are they? Hmm...

The Trolls used to be more intelligent...

h: Murk! It’s good that you're here. Where's Skulnar? What happened here?

t: Ahh... He's not with you? Maybe he went to take a leak...
h: Yes, Murk. Where is Skulnar? A giant orc!

t:
The rrest of the group can't move on while these turrets are firing. We need to deactivate them. I have an idea... I'm not sure whether it will work out. You are faster than me, so take this. This thing creates a ghost... I mean, a hologram of a dancing Elven lady. One frriend of mine gave it to me. Now finally it will make some use!

The plan is simple - turn this thing on, and hopefully, the turrets will take the hologram for an enemy. And while they are firing on it, sneak by and deactivate them!
Aho! Hush! Duck, and keep your head down. There are turrets on that cliff, and they are really irritated by our prresense, ha! See that burn on my fur? I hardly dodged!

Ay-hya! You refuse to fight... I don't get you, eysh!

Alright, if you want to negotiate, trry to negotiate. Observe their reaction and tell Zimina what to do next. If anything goes wrong, I will gladly rrip their Chief's head off!
h: Refuse to attack Tungars and try to negotiate, as Zimina suggests

t: Ancestors' spirrits don't hear me among the frozen lands...
Now I hear a real hunter. What can be better than a good fight? Ay-hya! Ancestors' spirrits will guide our blades! Let's tear the stinkers!
Alright then! Go ahead! You always need blood, don't you? I am washing my hands of it.
h: Refuse to negotiate and attack, as Murk suggests

t:
It's good you're not like Murk. Why do you think we gave him that name? Our furry friend is a little bit too bloodthirsty!

Alright, let's try and negotiate with the savages. You know, Semer Zemehoff, the greatest expert on relict languages, used to be my teacher. I think we will come to an understanding. Just observe their reactions and tell me how to behave. Don't provoke their aggression!

It would be good to know what can provoke it...

I'm here on behalf of Nadezhda Sialova. Our abbess wants to find out if there really are witches here. Yes, I've heard about Nessora. I hope you'll help us find her along with all her accomplices.

I can't wait to burn their feet with hot iron!

Hah! Now there are more warrior clans than anything else!

What's the most honorable activity for an orc? War, of course! So most of our clans are led by warriors.

I'm getting tired of listing them, and I'll probably forget someone. But listen here: the Merciless, the Gallant, the Rowdy, the Swift-Footed, the Quick, the Hungry, the Greedy, the Iron, the Bony, the Forester, the Awry, the Bloodthirsty, the Insatiable, the Brassbound, the Scorched, the Paunchy, the Skillful, the Steel, the Brassy, the Sated, the Sober, the Honest, the Crazybrick, the Speedy - they are all the true warrior clans!
h: Which clans report to the warriors?

t: What are you looking at? Want a shiner?

At the beginning, we thought it was some nonsense. Something the shamans hallucinated!

In the service of the Empire, we had everything we needed: food, booze, women!

But Yasker signed a peace treaty with the League. Agrh... The Architects are defeated! Demons, damn their tentacles, are also our friends... And now the undead are fighting at the Citadel.

There's nothing for the Orcs to do! We sat there in the garrison with no money - after all, they don't pay extra for the war anymore, so it's boring...

And then there's Fury... She might be a woman, but she's so strong she can take any guy. She'd say, "let's go guys, we'll set fire to the headquarters and take off." So that's what we did.

The Orcs need their freedom! So we can decide for ourselves if we want to fight!
h: What do the warriors think about the rebellion?

t:
Quiet, you fools. Or everyone's going to find out...

Ah, it's you! Hello, hello! Listen, do you know anyone who has a head for ship reactors?

May your days last forever, strangers. How may I help you? I know no more than others do. One fairy tale I heard might seem curious to you, though.

A while ago our beloved sultan, may the Lord extend his days, wished to beget an heir to his throne. Months went on, but none of his wives conceived. Sultan summoned doctors and healers from all over the universe, but all was in vain. Then one day the Grand Vizir told Sultan about a witch who knew a recipe of an ancient magic potion. She was summoned and ordered to brew the potion for the sultan. And in exchange the sultan promised to fulfill one of her wishes. Her wish was as follows: if a son was born, he would be the next the sultan, but if a daughter was born, the witch will take her with her.

The sultan gave his word. Nine months passed, and a beautiful girl Guzel was born. The sultan loved her with all his heart and felt that giving her away would be like ripping it out. He ordered the guards to throw the witch out of the city. So the witch cursed the baby girl. As soon as she turned eighteen, a snake would bite her, and she would die, said the witch.

A tower floating in the Astral was built. No snake could ever reach it. Guzel would have to stay in this tower until she turned eighteen years old. This day has come. Today is her eighteenth birthday!
Are you out of your mind, zoor? The place swarms with monsters! I'm not getting out of here, no way.
h: Send the Priden woman to the harbor

t: Civilization, they said! Safety, they said! Hot water all year long... Shoish! Stupid tailless!

Many people, youngling. They saw the labor of slaves on plantations, they heard the whip of the slave driver.

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. The palms will always be here. They will see everything. A slavery of body became a slavery of spirit. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the palms will always be here.

Don't you know? I command all Aviaks on Irene. I train Aviaks, maintain discipline, report everything to the king! Now I'm watching over the Galleon Castle! Then I'll go back to Irene to prepare the troops for the assault on Forox. We will overthrow the evil mage and restore the true faith! Yes... yes! We're setting out soon, I'll need to gather the Aviaks!
Greetings, guest! Have you been to Irene before? Have you noticed how beautiful it is?
I told you, I've got them all!
Did you come to see my menagerie? They're so sweet, aren't they? Each in its own way. I'm happy to know that my babies can make people smile even in these dark times.

Oh, do you? Excellent! It's quite amusing, although not very simple. I dedicated all my life to this business. Well, listen.

This is the thing I took away from a crazy Arisen. He was using it to torture animals. I'm not going to tell you what I did to him... And then I gave it a good thought, and I decided, waste not, want not, right? I untied this, fastened that, and look at it now! It's working for a good cause.

Life sensor will let you know if there's a rare animal (and not only animal) within 200 yards. It registers only animal presence. It won't react to every living being.

It's called a Tamer. I didn't rename it, only adjusted its properties. It can reduce animal's natural suspicion and aggression. You know, just to keep them from swallowing you whole.

Here, take it. Don't worry if you lose it. I can give you another.

Even if you fail to catch a pet, you will receive the Pet Symbol - proof of your efforts... 100 of these symbols can be exchanged for one random pet.
h: I want to tame rare pets!

t: I told you, I've got them all!
And happiness was so close...! But my fate was already decided.
Look who’s here? How dare you enter the house of the Light? Do you want to befoul it with the lies about crocodile god? No way!
Lie! You are pagans! If you really believe in the Light, prove it! Come through death, and return alive!
h: I praise the Light! I come from the Church of the Light! This is the official messenger of the Church!

quests: Pledge of Punishment: Disciples of Tep
The Undead Come in All Shapes and Sizes
Serment de châtiment : les Cultistes de Tep
Serment de châtiment : Cultistes de Tep

t: I tell her, "At least you can't complain about my ill temper, madam."
Our road will be tough and dangerous. We will need your help.
I've said all that I had to say. Now I am leaving you.

So, you were able to defeat our brother... And he thought it would be right to give his mask to you? I can hardly believe that.
I can neither confirm nor disprove your words. All I can do is test you. Go to the Dusty Ruins. There you'll meet the one you're looking for. Or your death, if your lips speak nothing but lies!

Argh! Bastard! What do you want from me?
What? A weak spot of Yasker? Are you insane? Why should I care? Do you think I follow his every step?
Why, he is the leader. But I don't think it will last long. Soon everyone will realize that he is not the one we need. We will find ourselves a new leader - an Orc, of course!
You can get an answer, but in this world, knowledge has shape. Will you sacrifice the integrity of your soul for this?
The guardian of the Show Stele is silent.

Then listen... This is a very old story. I am the one who was robbed.

He appeared from afar. He words were full of beauty and reason.

He talked about what we could do together. About strength that should serve Harmony. About worlds to create.

It was all a lie! A lie! He only wanted power for himself! He didn’t want Harmony. He wanted to create a cage for the other Creator. The perfect prison that could never be broken.

I was a fool. I gave him the power he needed. He simply laughed and disappeared. He is only lies. He is only Chaos.

Next time, I won’t be so foolish. I will become Order. I will bring Order to my world. I will bring Order to them all. No more lies. No more Chaos. Only perfect Harmony.

Well, well, well!

What do we have here? Ah, it's you, ! And, of course, we could not miss such an opportunity. I had to leave the village for now! I'm glad there is peace and quiet. We are getting settled, chatting with the locals, learning about the customs of some distant antiquity which is not really antiquity at all.

Yes, but there is something to compare - our Threads diverged a long time ago, so we forgot a lot, misinterpreted things out of ignorance... we must now bring everything together. Perhaps we'll do this...

The Thread Keepers, for example - they can tell us so much! That is the wisdom preserved by the ancestors... And we will write it down.
Look me in the eye. Sleep! Sleep...

I will cast you into a trance. You will see the future - not the inevitable, but the possible one. Don't be afraid! If you can defeat the shadows of the future, you can defeat them in the present, too.

What’s weird, is that they didn’t hinder us land and dock. And they turned all their cannons to face the other side, the ship graveyard. What are they waiting to come from there? The Flying Kaniaman? I don’t get it at all.

I’m helping those capable of opposing the Darkness.

Good intentions and good deeds should be amply rewarded, correct?

I’m helping those capable of opposing the Darkness...

Unfortunately, you are not one of them.

Ugh... Aren’t you confusing me with someone?

Don’t you have a better use for Mirra? This is not a Purgatory. Or do you want me to send you there?

Cut it out and go. Considering what we’re up against, you’ll get there soon enough.
Dark times are upon us, my friend. What do you do to oppose the Curse?
It’s a shame. Such a pure soul - and the Darkness has its teeth in you...
As you can see… sometimes daggers don't kill you. Erfar is still a bastard, but I'm not destined to die by his hand.
As you can see... I left you after that mess with the Gray Prince and ended up here.
Yes, and that's sad. Knowing the future, you do everything in your power to avert it, but nothing comes of it. It's a bitter lesson, but I'm not the first to challenge fate.
h: It looks like you were right... Everything happened as you predicted...

t: Hmm. You want the rock? Rock is strong, rock flies, rock strikes... A good rock, a faithful rock. I will give it to you...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Caw! We need to find a solution as soon as possible. If the tree has weakened, we need to understand why... The power of the First is great but not infinite. The rift keeps growing, and we suffer more losses...
Caw! Wait. I can sense that we will need my powers later... My sacrifice will help everyone.

Not all of the First are kind. Do you remember Toros, the mammoth from the depths of time that you had the chance to slay on Ferris? Once he was one of us, but even before the split of the world, his madness led to imprisonment and oblivion. There were many deities on Isa. Some of them were kind or indifferent to mortals, and some were plain evil...

One who is free is not afraid of anything! This is just another flight...

quests: The Identity of the Ice Monster

t:
It was Hoof's idea. Here was the only passage to the valley behind the mountains, and now nobody will get into our lands! Hoof is the boss, and I am his faithful assistant, huh. Now Chelezny will have to take us into account!

What else do you want to hear? About the Prophet? He doesn't exist. All that gibberish about the Ascension and the Order is nonsense. Hoof came up with everything to fool the dumb citizens. All we needed was money. Ugh... Call the doctor, please, I'm not feeling well...
What are you smiling at? You think you've won? Like I give a damn now...

Good day! I'm Rdyana Zharova, transportation department manager.

I'm responsible for transportation. We have a new special transport, based on Spinner's spare parts. It's an all-terrain vehicle. We call it Termite.

Here we have an experimental mode. Do you want to have one for yourself?

You'll have to work hard for it and earn some Dendrite Coins. I'm selling goods for them.
Do you want to know more about wolf mounts, our loyal frriends and helpers? Then ask me, eysh!

Don't you know that, Enlightened? Just use the leash, and the wolf cub will go to your stable. It will be with you wherever you go on Howlem. But the Golases have strrictly forbidden our wolves to follow their masters outside our allod!
h: Ask what to do with the leash

t: Ah, I see. The wolf has returned to me, and I was afraid that something had happened to you, eysh! Don't worry, untamed wolf cubs usually do that. You can take your loyal frriend, but next time, be careful and don't let him chase mountain snakes!
h: Say that the wolf has run away

t:
Here, take it. It's not just the fourth shard of the Crystal Armor. It's a milestone which means that you are now halfway closer to the Revelation.
Go ahead, Master's Voice is waiting for you. Don't worry about me, our mission here is not complete yet.

What...? What sphere? Oh, fine...

You can have it. I wanted to start shooting manavids, but I guess it wasn't meant to be... But you treated me with nothing but kindness, even brought me food. So here, take it.

Just don't tell them I took it, alright? The Factory people won't understand. Tell them Alice took it. She'll get away with it. She even plays a role in that movie.
h: Is it yours? Where's the SACK, Trunk?

t: Oh, thanks! I'll add you to my list.
Oh, there's some rebellion going on. I don't want that. I'm kind of a jester - I've spent all my life making people laugh. Why would I want to go to war?
h: Why aren't you with the Orcs?

t: Hello, everyone! Am I'm Orc announcer!

I'm a... I mean... An Orc announcer! I work at the local mana radio!

Or... I used to. They kicked me out.

Why? I don't know. Never figured it out. They laughed at me, asking, "Are you for the alliance between the League and Empire or for the new Orc Horde?" Sang some mocking song about mud and swamps... It's a nightmare.

Now I'm sitting here, collecting money to go to the canteen. I'm too poor!

Hello! I'm an orc announcer, and this is Nina. We are at the celebration of the Anniversary.

Actually, I'm not sure why I was invited, but I didn't refuse! Who can say no to a party?! And there are other outcasts here, just like you and me. It's a shame they kicked you out for something you didn't do... But maybe things will be better in the future!
I'm an orc announcer! Reporting live from this amazing event called the Allods Anniversary!
In an instant! I hope I don’t get the spell wrong...
h: Teleport to the thicket of the forest

t: Close your eyes... One, two, three!

Good afternoon!

I'm Tsuga, a Sunbunnies herder. These cute animals are very useful. They don't let the clearings overgrow with herbs and weed. Besides fur, Sunbunnies are full of nice nutritious ambrosia.

I can offer you one. Do you have enough Tears of All-Mother?

h: Take the parts of the amulet

t: What brought you out here to this bleak land?

Hic...! Wow, that's some... s-strong stuff! Really f-feeling it now... I met someone... Tekyan, I think. They are s-sort of our distant kin, yeah? W-we should invite them here... Offer our m-mead... Hic!
Not everyone can fool death. I did it... Twice... And now? Now everyone can do that?!

h: Do you have something for me?

t:
Greetings on behalf of all Tycoons.

My colleagues are very busy, alas, but they asked me to give you their regards. And of course, allow me to thank you again for saving Dane.

I must admit, I'm not here simply to enjoy myself. When these cultists of Order occupied my Winter Palace, they stole an extremely rare collection of elven trinkets. I'm currently trying to find out where they might have ended up. It appears that Hoof managed to sell them already. Does the name Gray Prince mean anything to you? No? Pity.

, how could I miss this celebration? I'm sorry I wasn't able to attend the Great Ball!

Though I admit it allowed me to avoid certain uncomfortable questions. The thing is, many of the treasures in my Winter Palace came from Irene!

I still don't have the most precious one! They say Hoof sold everything in the Black Market - someone known as Gray Prince bought it. A mysterious person that left a notable mark in the history of the world! I'm not sure if it's a title or something else, but he's extremely dangerous and cunning!

But let's not talk about it now... So, are you having fun? It's a celebration in your honor, after all!

!

I'm glad to see you at this celebration. You probably understand that, in addition to the celebration of the beginning of your journey, we have also gathered here for a very important purpose – to discuss the details of the future undertaking. And Catherina plays a big part in it.

Ambrosia. This resource that has appeared out of nowhere and turned out to be very valuable. With its help, we will be able to change the appearance of Sarnaut. It gave a new impulse to mana power engineering and made it possible to create things that we'd only dreamed of.

That is why we must find its source - the place where it's abundant. The Expedition we are mounting includes representatives from both the League and the Empire. The Free Traders will also be there - we provide the funding in exchange for a portion of the profits.

The expedition will be a risky undertaking, but we are ready for anything.

Ahem! To be honest, our enterprise in Eden turned out to be much more difficult than I imagined. And all this talk about ethics... Well, let's just say it's not very ethical! But who raises these questions? The Orcs who stirred up a rebellion? The Gibberlings who have already lost their homeland? The Pridens who force their children to survive? Don't talk to me about ethics.

We Free Traders must think about profit! Not worry about offending someone's sensibilities. We need the Ambrosia, it's the only thing that can open the way to rapid progress!
Greetings on behalf of all Tycoons.
Gash-halee... Tyk heard about you. You fight like a lynx! We you walk, the snow is red.

Tyk was never defeated! You are strength! Your minion is strength! Tyk look at the best chief!

Tyk make a vow - your head on a spike. Tyk failed. Tyk ashamed!

Booka-Booka chief now kill Tyk. Do you fight Booka-Booka? Tyk will help you, goon-galash!
What do you want, funny cub?

You remind me of our cubs. They were just as weak and funny like you... Then one day Akkya called the Pack for the Big Hunt, and when me and Itkan returned to our den, the younglings were gone. The forest took them. For many moons we mourned over them, but never had children again...
Akkya is old, but he is strong and wise. He's a good and just leader, but if you want to survive, you will have to find more supporters among the Pack.

Aho, kinsman! We are all roots of one tree that is reaching out for the light. The tree cannot survive without its branches, and so can't we, eysh!

When you enter a Branch, you swear an oath to serve your people. Your thoughts are the thoughts of the kin. Your actions are the actions of the kin. The Golases' Word is the word of the kin, eysh!

The spirits will entrrust you with responsibility to defend and serve your kin, then they will leave to Yao Realm. You will pass your duty on to the future generations! The leaves fall down from the brranches to let the new life begin. The life that you are starting today!

The Golases hear you, kinsman. Making a decision takes time. Each of them wants new a sprrout in their Branch, especially since you are the Enlightened! This is why we appeal to the Primals and ask them to help us define your destiny.

Not all Primals live in the forest-between-worlds. Four of them stayed with us after all the misfortunes that their people had to go through. They possess a special power, and a part of it is contained in each of us. Here in the Temple we have built the statues of the Primals, and you can feel an echo of that power if you touch them. Its trrace will show the Golases which Branch should accept the new sprrout, eysh!
You look disturbed, Enlightened. Has something happened on your way to Yao Realm?

Shoysh! Gahir-kumur shoysh! If we find that outlander, he will die slowly! Very, very slowly, eysh!

So this stone was the heart of the arrtifact that blocked the way between the worlds, zoor? I feel odd power in it. It's not evil, it's not kind; it's just power. This stone is very old... I think it's a part of something bigger.

We will try and figure out what it is. Tyym-Khos is waiting for you! I bet he is regretting he has given the right of blood to the Maas Branch!
h: Tell about the intrusion into Yao Realm

t:
Aho, kylys!

We are the defenders of Howlem, the Illuminated Ones. When we learned that someone was gathering all the believers in the Light to fight against the Kingdom of Darkness, we decided to join them! Now we are here, fighting together with Hiero's Paladins. Like the others, we protect the Cathedral and the people. And we are not going anywhere, eysh.

quests: Catch the Winds of Luck Again

t: My name is Tyym-Tulgat the Invincible. I deserved this name by devoting my life to protection of Pridens.

Our ally is the Light. Or the Fire. Or the Gift. Whatever you call it. Words do not matter. Only faith matters! Your faith in your duty, in your people and your destiny, eysh! While we believe, the Light is with us, and we put its Flames in each our strike, into each our word!

I can see understanding in your eyes. You know what power I am talking about. But you've never met an enemy that you could use it against, right? Will fix that now.

Once I captured a powerful spirit and contained it in my amulet. It can't be killed with a regular weapon, but it fears the power of the Light. I will release it now, and you will force it back into the amulet. It will see that it is no match for you and hide. All dark spirits are cowardly, eysh!
My advice is: less counsels and meetings, more action.

Are you interested? Yes, now is the time when old enemies forget their feuds and start working together... It would seem that we should rejoice - but we shouldn't forget that a similar period of peace ended with the Cataclysm.
I see the despair on your faces, but all is not lost yet...
I need to collect my thoughts, clear my mind. What is distance? Just an illusion.
I see the despair on your faces, but all is not lost yet...
I need to collect my thoughts, clear my mind. What is distance? Just an illusion.

The future is hidden in a haze... A fiery black, sinister haze. I have a very, very bad feeling about this.

The only good news is that the first sprouts have shown up in the New Land! The ice fields are melting, the snow banks are growing smaller... The earth is awakening! I hope I live to see the day when it blooms!
h: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

t: Oh, hello, child. Don’t look at me like I’m a ghost!

Later, beanpole! I'm not going to run to the village right now. I'm busy, understand? Affairs of the heart... You wouldn't believe the legs on this one! And she's got such pretty semi translucent webbings between those delicate toes... I would dry up the whole lake for my darling!
But you beanpoles will never understand our sense of beauty!
Well then, good luck to you. Be sure to come around again. Our villagers are always happy to see you.

The Demon emits waves of resentment. However, he's not irritated by you, but by some creature on the bridge.

In spite of the invasion threat, this Demon doesn't seem to be willing to leave the burgeoning grove in the city center. He has trapped the enemy Demon on the bridge, but he cannot hold him back for too long.
The Demon shakes his head. He seems to be taking his job very seriously.
